Part B
• Many responses simply stated that R is continuous
and differentiable without sufficient justification.
• Many responses did not show that the hypotheses
for the Intermediate Value Theorem were met or
tried to apply the wrong theorem:
o Some responses listed values that were
presented in the given table but did not clearly
indicate that R c ( ) = 155 is between the listed
values.
o Some responses did not state that R is
continuous.
o A few responses incorrectly attempted to apply
the Mean Value Theorem in their justification.
• R is continuous because R is differentiable.
OR
R is differentiable; therefore R is continuous.
OR
R is differentiable implies R is continuous.
• Because R is continuous and
R(0) =90 < < 155 (10) 162, the Intermediate
Value Theorem guarantees that there must be a
value c, 0 < c < 10, such that R c ( ) = 155.
